deals.headline: Corinthians' FIP buys Novonor's stadium interests (UPI Arena) for a symbolic R$1
deals.investor: SCCP Fundo de Investimento em Participações Multiestratégia (FIP Corinthians, 100% owned by the club)
deals.source_name: Sport Club Corinthians Paulista — Relatório de Demonstrações Financeiras 2025, nota 1.2
deals.summary: In Novonor's judicial recovery, the club's FIP bought the 'UPI Arena' (SPE UPI Arena S.A. shares, the 2nd-issue Arena Itaquera debentures and Novonor's other rights as shareholder and creditor) for R$1.00, backed by an Apsis valuation, then capitalised the debt into 774,454,779 new Arena Itaquera shares; the club now controls the whole stadium structure.

deals.headline: Neo Química Arena loan with Caixa restructured to December 2041 at CDI + 2%
deals.investor: Caixa Econômica Federal (BNDES Pró-Copa Arenas funds)
deals.source_name: Sport Club Corinthians Paulista — Relatório de Demonstrações Financeiras 2025, nota 1.2(c)
deals.summary: The 2013 Caixa/BNDES stadium loan was renegotiated: 19-year term to December 2041, rising amortisation from 2025, interest at CDI + 2% a year, secured on Parque São Jorge property, all Arena Itaquera shares and FII quotas, 100% of naming rights and part of ticketing, player-sale, prize and Brasileirão TV receivables. In September 2026 the club formally proposed to Caixa to settle the debt, then about R$630m (Lance).

deals.headline: Fan crowdfunding for the stadium debt raises about R$41.1m of a R$700m target
deals.summary: The Gaviões da Fiel supporters' group ran a one-year donation campaign to pay down the Caixa stadium loan; it closed on 26 Nov 2025 having raised about R$41.1m, around 5.8% of the R$700m goal.

name: Sport Club Corinthians Paulista
notes: Accounts are calendar-year 2025 (R$ thousands in the PDF). Revenue is net operating revenue (gross R$863.685m); player trading (R$107.405m of income) is reported separately below 'Resultado Operacional recorrente'. The stadium debt sits in Arena Itaquera S.A./Arena FII, outside the club's balance sheet; Lance (29 Sep 2026) puts the arena debt with Caixa at about R$630m — no stated net debt, so net_debt is null. The static.corinthians.com.br PDF sits behind an AWS WAF challenge for some user agents (fetch with a browser UA and the transparency page as referer). Honours: the club's titles page lists seven Campeonato Brasileiro titles (1990, 1998, 1999, 2005, 2011, 2015, 2017) but states no count, so honours is left null. No dated follower counts found. Corinthians joined the Liga Forte União (LFU) for collective media rights in July 2024 (2025–2029 contract); whether the LFU's sale of commercial rights to investors binds Corinthians was not verified, so no league-stake deal is recorded. Registry CNPJ not found on a citable page. Betting sponsors: a provisional measure (MP) announced 25 Sep 2026 bans betting operators and their advertising in Brazil from 6 Oct 2026 (Máquina/MKT Esportivo, 2 Oct 2026), so a betting-house shirt sponsor may not survive the season. Corinthians is weighing short one-off master-sponsor deals for the last ten rounds; Esportes da Sorte's continuation is undecided.
